G1_unambiguity.justification: The function definitions, security properties, certificates, and uniqueness guarantee determine a single interpretation of every valid input.

G2_completeness.justification: All bounds, input formats, output formats, feasibility conditions, and relevant edge cases are specified.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Causality fails exactly when p1+p2 exceeds T, while query and reply independence fail exactly when the corresponding total exceeds T, preserving the original certificates and outputs.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is grammatically clear and coherent, though the cryptographic-function framing is somewhat contrived compared with the underlying scheduling problem.
